limits: census checks primary keys, categories and independently regenerated norms; it does not project and compare every vector coordinate
pre-ready SIGKILL is verified; there is no internal recovery progress hook
full workflow has no per-request deadline and is not a formal time-limit pass
kernel 6.5 cannot reset memory.peak; phase M is cumulative since workflow start
memory.peak includes file cache; sampled anon/file maxima are not additive
phase T excludes external oracle generation; no phase weights are invented

workload.cache_policy: private inode; verified cold before every startup and cold batch; same-process replay with no eviction
workload.filter_scope: all live categories are c9; c9 filter covers every live row, not 10 percent
workload.memory_accounting: fresh cgroup per trial, cumulative peak; only service_total M is comparable
workload.timing: startup before exec; both batches include protocol/output; oracle, decoding and eviction excluded; service total includes startup+cold+replay+shutdown

limitations: Local exact query-service T/B/M only; no write-phase weight, overall performance score or platform extrapolation.
Stage E uses T/B/M=0.6/0.2/0.2 with 1ms/1MiB/1MiB smoothing and the first three baseline medians; stages are not combined by invented weights.
service_total adds startup+cold+replay+shutdown T/B and takes maximum M; excludes preparation, cache eviction and external truth/validation.
cold means cold row pages at batch start; later queries may reuse pages and derived state.
replay retains the same process, derived state and remaining page cache; it does not claim the >2GiB vectors are fully resident.
All live categories are c9, so the c9 filter covers the entire table; this is not a selective-category benchmark.
Repeated responses are individually checked against independent truth; unique SQL cases are counted separately.
Sampled anon/file maxima may occur at different instants and cannot be added; M is the fresh-cgroup whole-trial lifetime kernel peak.
Null paired ratios mean the reference metric is zero; those rounds remain in raw metrics and stage E.
No per-request deadline is enforced; this is not evidence of passing a formal time limit.

preserved_failures.label: remote-quad-fallback-tests
preserved_failures.reason: 两项旧测试在强制关闭 SIMD 后仍要求 SIMD 计数增加；修复测试的条件断言，完整标量引擎测试随后通过，生产逻辑未改。

preserved_failures.label: remote-final-fallback
preserved_failures.reason: 驱动完整成功且独立真值零错误，但 SIMD/标量距离末位不同使原严格响应哈希汇总失败。保留原记录，另以诊断驱动审计，不计算该比较的 E。

preserved_failures.reason: 包装器将 pathlib.Path 写入 JSON，启动数据库前失败；失败文件未覆盖，修复 str(GO) 后用 stress-v2 完成全流程。

remaining_issues: 正式隐藏 MySQL case、准备/请求时限及平台排名未运行；未正式提测、推送或发送外部消息。
AMD 5975WX 不支持 AVX-VNNI/AVX512；相关历史代码保持能力门控，本机没有执行或重新证明这些指令路径。
127 维短负载有负收益，第二个种子的长负载基本持平；大数据查询服务约慢 0.5%，不能宣称所有场景加速。
Linux 6.5 memory.peak 不支持重置：capacity 为整段流程峰值，大数据比较只给完整试次可比较的 M/E。
2 GiB memory.max 始终设置且 swap=0，内核记录的 capacity 峰值高出上限 4096 字节，OOM/OOM kill 均为零。
大数据全量核对覆盖主键、类别、独立再生的范数，并非投影比较每个坐标；独立 TopK 在各事务/恢复状态另外验证。
本地性能结果受到共享服务器调度与 I/O 波动影响；保留逐轮数据、配对比值和负收益，不作正式分数预测。
